items.text: Suppose, you are Maha, a student of class eight in Pirbari Girls’ High School, Manikganj. Write an application to the Headmaster on behalf of all the students of your school requesting him to take necessary steps in setting up a multimedia classroom in your school.
items.explanation:
Sample answer:
20 November 2026
The Headmaster
Pirbari Girls’ High School
Manikganj

Subject: Request for a multimedia classroom.

Dear Sir,

On behalf of the students of our school, I request you to consider setting up a multimedia classroom. Pictures, videos and presentations would help teachers explain difficult topics and make lessons more engaging. We would be grateful if you could arrange the necessary equipment and training, according to the resources available.

Yours faithfully,
Maha
Class Eight
On behalf of the students

items.text: Suppose, you are Shamim or Shamima, a student of Khilgaon High School, Dhaka. Many students in your school are interested in going on a study tour. Write an application to the Headmaster for permission to go on a study tour.
items.explanation:

20 November 2026
The Headmaster
Khilgaon High School
Dhaka

Subject: Permission for a study tour.

Dear Sir,

Many students of our school wish to go on a study tour. A supervised visit to a museum or another educational place would help us learn beyond the classroom. Shamim
Class Eight
